rationale: The Latin anchors *ire*, *venire*, *gradi*, *procedere*, and *scandere/scando* all point to literal physical movement — going, coming, walking, proceeding, and climbing. The synset `proceed.v.02` ("move ahead; travel onward in time or space") best captures this concrete sense of forward locomotion, as also confirmed by the Old English attestations in narrative/travel contexts (Andreas, Beowulf, etc.).
